```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 10_confidence_intervals_design
title: >
  Think of a Design
questions:
  - id: single_sample_design
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Think of a research design that would call for a single-sample t-test.
    answer: >
      A good answer describes one sample being compared with a known or
      theoretically expected population mean, while the population standard
      deviation is unknown.
    explanation: >
      For example, compare Barnard students' average sleep to an expected value of 8
      hours, estimating variability from the sample.
```
